images.alt: View of Lyttelton Harbour from the top of Bridle Path, which was used as an emergency route following the 2011 earthquake.

post.text:
Tracks save lives in emergencies. Herenga ā Nuku is leading a national project to enhance track data for the emergency management community, in partnership with LINZ. Better data = faster access for communities and emergency response teams. 
www.herengaanuku.govt.nz/our-work/new...
#GIS #geospatial
